description: Layout components + Landing page cyberpunk redesign. Rebuild Navigation with a cyberpunk HUD bar style (scanline top border, neon glow on active link, glitch logo animation on hover, animated mobile drawer). Upgrade AdminSidebar with neon active states, collapsible animation, role badge with neon styling, and SHARD/TICK strip at the bottom. Redesign LandingPage (src/components/LandingPage.tsx) with: glitch-animated hero title, enhanced HeroScene particles (already exists — wrap with improved gradient overlay), animated stats counter row (active servers/tournaments/players), neon feature cards with grid overlay, scrolling ticker tape, and a CTA section. Depends on FEAT-001 (new CSS utilities and motion variants).
steps: 1. Redesign apps/web/src/components/ui/Navigation.tsx. Keep the exact same data-fetching pattern (fetch /api/auth/me in useEffect). Visual changes: change nav background to 'bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[rgba(6,182,212,0.15)]' (neon cyan bottom border); add a 1px top stripe in violet: 'border-t border-[rgba(124,58,237,0.4)]'; make the LEGENDARY ESPORTS logo use NeonText component with glitch=true and a hover:animate-[glitch-clip_0.3s_steps(2,end)] class; add 'SERVERS' and 'TOURNAMENTS' nav links (pointing to /servers and a generic #) alongside 'Docs'; style active links with neon-text-cyan and a bottom 2px neon-border-cyan underline; style inactive links with text-[#94a3b8] hover:text-white; user dropdown gets a GlassCard neonColor='violet' styling; add a thin animated scan line div absolutely positioned at bottom of nav that plays once on page load using the hud-slide-in animation; keep all existing mobile menu and auth logic unchanged. File: apps/web/src/components/ui/Navigation.tsx

2. Redesign apps/web/src/components/admin/AdminSidebar.tsx. Keep exact same props, role-based filtering, and collapse toggle logic. Visual changes: change background to 'bg-[#050508] border-r border-[rgba(124,58,237,0.2)]'; active nav item gets 'bg-[rgba(124,58,237,0.12)] border-l-2 border-[#7c3aed] text-white' with a neon violet box-shadow left glow; inactive items get 'text-white/50 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 border-l-2 border-transparent'; add a <StatusBar> component import from ui/StatusBar rendered inside the sidebar footer (instead of just the user block) so referees see SHARD status; wrap each nav icon with a motion.span that plays a brief scaleIn on mount using staggerChildren; the server header gets a neon-border-violet ring around the guild icon; role label badge uses the Badge 'cyber' variant; user footer gets a divider line in neon cyan. File: apps/web/src/components/admin/AdminSidebar.tsx

3. Rebuild apps/web/src/components/LandingPage.tsx. Keep all existing sections but apply major visual upgrades — do NOT change any href links, auth logic, or server calls. Section 1 (Hero): add a <NeonText as='h1' color='violet' glitch={true}> wrapper around 'LEGENDARY ESPORTS'; add a subtitle line in JetBrains Mono cyan 'MULTI-SERVER ESPORTS PLATFORM v2.0'; below the existing buttons add an animated stats row of three <GlassCard hud> cards each containing an <AnimatedCounter> for static placeholder values (servers:120+, tournaments:1400+, players:28000+) with mono font — these are static display numbers; add a horizontal scrolling ticker tape between hero and features sections (using CSS marquee animation): a div with 'overflow-hidden whitespace-nowrap' containing a span that scrolls left using CSS animation, text content is 'BGMI • FREE FIRE • COD MOBILE • LIVE TOURNAMENTS • REAL-TIME SYNC • DISCORD NATIVE •' repeated, styled in neon cyan mono small caps. Section 2 (Features): each GlassCard gets neonColor='violet' and scanline; add a 4-digit hex 'system code' in top-right corner of each card (e.g. #F001, #F002, #F003) styled in JetBrains Mono text-white/20 text-xs; header 'BUILT DIFFERENT' wrapped in NeonText. Section 3 (Games): add gradient border animation (tournament-card-glow class) on each game card; game name uses NeonText matching each game's accentColor. Section 4 (How It Works): step badges get a neon ring border matching step colours (violet, cyan, green). Footer: add a version string 'SYS v2.0.0 | BUILD $(current year)' in mono text-white/20. File: apps/web/src/components/LandingPage.tsx

4. Verify that HeroSceneWrapper (apps/web/src/components/three/HeroSceneWrapper.tsx) uses dynamic import with ssr:false — read the file first and if it already does, no change needed. If not, update it. File: apps/web/src/components/three/HeroSceneWrapper.tsx (read-only check or minor fix)
acceptance_criteria: Navigation renders LEGENDARY ESPORTS with NeonText glitch, has cyan bottom border stripe
AdminSidebar renders with neon active state and StatusBar in footer
LandingPage renders with stats row, ticker tape, and game cards with gradient border animation
No existing functionality (auth, links, data fetching) was removed or broken
